Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was familiar with gas grills when they first came out.  I worked a swimming pool store during college summers and saw the best of the best of the only 2 companies that made them - Charm glow and Arkla.  Those were the days of the cast aluminum shell, American stainless steel cooking grates, cast iron burners, and volcanic rocks.  The closest grill today is the Spirit II E-310.  I have been through the cheaper models at the big box stores, the repair contracts, the more expensive models, and the supposedly stainless steel models made in China.  All were poorly designed but looked good.  Never lasted more than 2 years and repair contracts that essentially, after the fine print kicked in, repaired nothing.  I finally looked at the Webers, which I was avoiding because I thought were too expensive. I found the Spirit II which was very well made, well designed, and relatively inexpensive.  No bottle storage under cart. No doors under cart. Both of the these features to me, are a positive, and even cost more.  I love the bottle hanging from the side with propane gas gauge. For me: Much easier to get to and safer.  I have cooked a turkey breast, hamburgers and rib eyes. Love the middle burner off indirect heat feature Grease pan emptying super slick feature.  The cast aluminum covers almost the entire bottom of the grill.  No steel bottom to rust like my last grill. 10 yr guarantee. The only regret - not buying one years ago.
Results.Title: Yesterday's well-made grill - engineered for today

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Very well constructed.  The heat is very even across the grill and easy to regulate.  I like the reversible grills that allow for different char patterns and width.  I suggest that you use the Weber grill spray before cooking to make clean-up easier after use.  I also have another grill from a different manufacturer at my vacation home, and it is an excellent and less expensive grill.  I think the Weber is better built and has a more even heat distribution.  The other grill seems more subject to flare-ups than the Weber.  Love the design for easy storage
Results.Title: Great gas grill

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
